Retarget those imports/call sites to the Workers service root contract so Sessions no longer depends on Workers implementation packages. Do not fold or delete sessions/service or workers/service; do not edit root pkg/wire; do not open PSS-I01/I02/I03/I04 shared integrators; do not admit Workers fold/DEL while Automations owns pkg/wire; do not invent Workers HTTP/CLI/MCP adapters; do not reopen CUT-SES-RUN or CUT-SES-WORK scope. Prove with focused Sessions/Workers boundary tests that Sessions constructs Workers requests only through the Workers root. Delivery contract: loop implementation and review until required CI is terminal green, every blocking PR conversation comment is addressed, merge conflicts are resolved, the PR is merged, and only then complete Factory work.
